_comment: The approved publishers: a dated list someone reviewed on a day, not a permanent judgement.
It decides whose conversions the shelf lists when browsing, and never what a typed repo id
reaches. Never invent an org: `author=` is EXACT-MATCH, so a wrong case or a renamed org
returns zero results, which is indistinguishable from 'this org has no models'.
Reviewed 2026-10-07 over the landing models (gemma 4, qwen 3.5 to 3.8), by 30-day downloads:
unsloth 66%, lmstudio-community 10%, ggml-org 9%, google's own files 8%, bartowski 6%.
google, Qwen and mistralai stay as releasers: their own GGUF repos lead a model's publishers.
LEFT at that review: mradermacher held the most repos over those models, two per model, for
0.2% of the downloads; its listing is the one a 1000-row page cut, and its draft-model repos
are the ones a pick could take. microsoft, nvidia and CohereLabs: their models sit in no family
on the chip row, so browsing never shows them.
ADDED 2026-10-20: prism-ml, for the 1-bit and ternary Bonsai conversions of qwen 3.6. By the
Hub's download counts that day, prism-ml/Bonsai-27B-gguf held 346,174 against unsloth's
Qwen3.6-27B-GGUF 430,219, and its ternary repo 2,999,667. Its Q1_0 files run on Vulkan with
the pinned llama.cpp, all layers on an 8 GB card. The quant floor keeps Q1_0 behind show all,
and the fork-only PQ2_0 and PTQ1_0 files carry no quant name gatto reads, so they never list.
Held the same day: its draft heads (-dspark-, -DFlash2-) sit mid-name and were priced as models.
Joined 2026-10-21, once model-kinds.json drops those heads at any position and a PQ2_0 file
whose name ends in its MTP part's Q8_0 reads no quant either, so it never lists as a Q8_0.
EXCLUDED, RULED 2026-08-10 (not pending, not an oversight - do not re-add at a dated review
without a new argument): TheBloke. gatto selects for models that TOOL-CALL RELIABLY and behave
agentically, and that capability did not exist in the 2024 models this org converted. Re-add
only if someone shows those conversions tool-call reliably through gatto's loop - which is a
measurement, not an opinion: that is exactly what `audition` answers.
